data_point: Legal entity type and state of incorporation
run_when: Code couldn't decide the entity type.

prompt.task: Determine the company's legal entity type and state of incorporation.
prompt.definition: Look in order: site footer (Inc., LLC, Corp., Ltd., PBC), terms governing law, privacy policy registered entity and address, app store developer name, legal or imprint page. 'Inc.' plus Delaware governing law confirms a Delaware C-Corp.
watch_out_for: Return exactly one of the allowed values, verbatim
A Public Benefit Corporation is its own value

evidence_quote.description: Exact words copied from the text. Empty when the answer is unknown.

source.description: Page name or URL the quote came from.

reason.description: One plain sentence explaining the answer.

examples.input_excerpt: Linear Orbit, Inc. ... governed by the laws of the State of Delaware

output.evidence_quote: governed by the laws of the State of Delaware
output.reason: An Inc. with Delaware governing law.
